absorbed_mechanisms.source_hardening: Rejected unsupported configuration_precedes causality and arbitrary custom spec projection; retained UID-grounded direct ownership relationship evidence.

Rejected production port: allowlist and generation checks do not independently provide durable locking, persistent idempotency, pre-effect audit intent, rollback drill evidence, or observer-independent effect verification for arbitrary custom resources.
Replaced fixed causal ranking with complete, globally unique webhook-name correlation and an explicit candidate-only claim.
Requires two distinct recent timeout events and one immutable affected-resource UID; rejects the source campaign's unproven NetworkPolicy and degraded-workload causal attribution.

Rejected field-basename validation over arbitrary custom-resource specs because no matching CRD OpenAPI schema or exact schema path proves Kubernetes security-context, toleration, or workload-strategy semantics; the bounded owner projection continues to exclude spec values.

Replaced name-only ownership and raw image disclosure with exact immutable UID-chain traversal, complete container projections, and SHA-256 image-reference fingerprints; retained candidate-only causality.

Rejected heuristic cross-namespace expansion based on kind-name pluralization and broad API-group read access; inventory remains target-scoped until CRD plural identity, exact RBAC semantics, complete projections, and a dedicated bounded capability are available.
Replaced name-only timeless event correlation with raw-message-safe classification, a five-minute trusted cutoff, exact Pod UID matching, complete hostPort projection, and candidate-only causality.
Added exact Pod UID and container identity, a five-minute trusted cutoff, a one-KiB record bound, raw-body suppression, and candidate-only causality; no concrete log provider is claimed.

Generalized active-failure prioritization into an exact-UID, complete-status selector that reserves half of each bounded Pod budget for recency and applies a separate container ceiling; no concrete log provider is claimed.

Rejected reason-specific authoritative RCA promotion because the strengthened host-port finding is candidate-only, does not prove Node socket ownership, and must not bypass generic evidence-strength and contradiction handling.

Replaced complete-namespace absence inference with one exact targeted Service absence receipt, complete webhook projection, conflict rejection, bounded evidence, and candidate-only causality; provider wiring remains unclaimed.

Bounds exact allowlisted optional Service reads to eight references, accepts only successful empty output as confirmed absence, isolates probe incompleteness from base admission findings, and rejects mismatched responses.

Rejected changing failurePolicy from Fail to Ignore for missing backends or TLS trust failures across proposer, policy, capability propagation, and action building: it changes admission security intent, restores neither backend nor trust, and lacks independent effect, rollback-outcome, and intended-control validation even with approval, shadow mode, and dry-run.
Projects and trusts only one exact kubernetes.io/metadata.name match label with no expressions; ambiguous selectors omit scope and readiness never expands impact to a workload.

Rejected opening a deny-all NetworkPolicy on a common backend port because the evidence proves neither API-server policy traversal nor a bounded source selector and lacks independent effect and rollback-outcome validation.

Requires a recent structured restricted-profile rejection, exact ReplicaSet and Deployment UIDs, a complete single-controller chain, degraded replica counts, and a closed violation vocabulary; emits only a candidate hold.

Rejected deterministic SecurityContext mutation because admission success does not independently validate rollout health, application behavior, rollback restoration, or all seven action safeguards; the live patch handler remains unregistered.

Requires a recent structured event, exact Pod-to-ReplicaSet-to-Deployment UID chain, degraded owner, and one identical privacy-safe probe plus startup-gate identity; rejects fixed sleep, second-read timing hacks, and reason-specific aggressive-schedule priority branches.

Rejected collecting a backend namespace's full inventory from a webhook Service reference; exact bounded Service receipts provide the required absence evidence without widening unrelated resource exposure.
Rejected treating deny-all policy selection of webhook backend Pods as proof of API-server traffic blockage; membership evidence does not establish the control-plane path or enforcement point.
Reuses the recent exact-UID and privacy-safe probe fingerprint kernel, requires a kubelet reporter, suppresses raw messages, and rejects fixed-delay second Event reads.

Requires complete required hostname anti-affinity, exact template labels, a mounted volume, one same-namespace RWO claim, degraded multi-replica counts, and candidate-only causality; concrete projection remains unclaimed.

Replaces raw command parsing and complete-namespace absence with an exact UID chain, identical command fingerprint, one structured Service dependency, one running init status, and a targeted absence receipt; provider projection remains unclaimed.
Replaces complete-namespace absence inference with a complete mounted-volume join and one exact targeted ConfigMap absence receipt; concrete projection remains unclaimed.

Requires complete RollingUpdate strategy evidence, zero available replicas, a degraded rollout, maxSurge zero, and maxUnavailable covering the desired count; retains candidate-only causality and leaves projection unclaimed.

Uses a bounded non-executing parser and accepts only one exact reviewed all-Service svc.cluster.local NXDOMAIN template; arbitrary, duplicate, malformed, and oversized patterns abstain, while projection remains unclaimed.

Rejected global Corefile mutation and restart because service resolution, CoreDNS rollout health, bounded blast radius, snapshot restoration, and independent outcomes are unvalidated; the live handler remains unregistered.

Requires complete empty endpoint evidence, a complete Service selector, one exact same-namespace workload label match, desired replicas zero, and candidate-only causality; concrete projection remains unclaimed.

Requires complete HPA metrics, one closed inactive metric condition, an exact target workload, complete container resource projections, parsed positive CPU quantities, and candidate-only causality; concrete projection remains unclaimed.
Generalizes decode, application-failure, and stream-stall tokens into repeated recent exact-Pod-UID candidates with one-KiB bounds, raw-body suppression, closed signal classes, and no provider claim.

Rejected CronJob template patching and active-child foreground deletion because source-owner normalization and churn tolerance do not prove durable locking, independent effect, rollback restoration, or bounded deletion outcomes.

Rejected fixed reason-specific causal precedence and authority labels; candidate-only findings require generic evidence-strength, contradiction, completeness, and freshness ordering before any authoritative promotion.

Rejected literal-regex-driven and deny-all NetworkPolicy restoration actions because textual risk and selector overlap do not establish traffic path, bounded source intent, independent effect, or rollback outcomes.

Rejected ClusterRole verb append and finalizer mutation authority: provenance joins and append verification do not prove least privilege, controller intent, independent reconciliation effect, revocation, or rollback outcomes.
Superseded by the current capability broker's effective allowed-id set, side-effect-class checks, expiring stage receipts, and separate substrate authority axes.
Superseded by current typed abstention envelopes and audit surfaces that require explicit nonempty reasons and preserve abstention independently from action authority.

Generation compare-and-swap is retained as a necessary future precondition but rejected as sufficient action authority because it does not provide durable locking, rollback, blast-radius, audit-intent, or independent outcome safeguards.
Superseded by current per-provider item/output limits, total evidence byte ceilings, response-over-limit fail-closed behavior, and independent capability receipts.

Rejected generic control-plane and namespace patch authority; path normalization and policy routing do not independently provide all seven safeguards or outcome validation, and live generic handlers remain unregistered.
Rejected fixed DNS-bypass and local-blast reason priority without a current complete DNS policy/search projection and generic evidence-strength ordering; no authority is inferred from locality alone.

Rejected CoreDNS and Service-selector mutation normalization and rollout convergence because DNS resolution, dependent traffic, rollout health, snapshot restore, and independent outcomes remain unvalidated.

Rejected priority, alias, and temporal-proximity quota causality without exact immutable affected-resource identity, trusted cutoff, complete quota projection, and contradiction handling; no new reason branch is added.
Rejected quota reversion because change proximity does not prove intent or safe prior value, and independent admission recovery, workload outcome, blast-radius, and rollback validation are absent.

Rejected datastore credential posture probes and Service attribution until a secret-free provider proves exact owner/selector identity, bounded authentication semantics, current freshness, and no credential material exposure.

Rejected auth-driven workload restart authority because selector/owner grounding and replacement waits do not prove credential recovery, application correctness, durable idempotency, rollback restoration, or independent outcomes.
Rejected catalog coverage as authority: catalog presence and asset isolation do not validate a provider, action, outcome, or promotion state.

groups.title: Bounded Kubernetes diagnostics foundation
groups.safety_boundary: Evidence remains bounded, untrusted, namespace-scoped, and unable to grant action authority.

groups.title: Ontology-first model escalation and wire compatibility
groups.safety_boundary: Escalation is configuration-driven, audited, and never raises execution authority.

groups.title: Workload lifecycle, identity provenance, bounded logs, and causal ranking
groups.safety_boundary: Owner traversal, selectors, generation guards, and destructive cleanup remain fail-closed until separately action-validated.

groups.title: Ordinary runtime evidence operationalization
groups.safety_boundary: Evaluation remains a thin consumer of the same operational evidence path used by normal agents.

groups.title: DNS diagnosis and governed CoreDNS recovery
groups.safety_boundary: Cluster-wide DNS mutation requires grounded target identity, dry-run, bounded scope, rollback, and independent convergence verification.

groups.title: Quota attribution, semantic quantities, and governed revert
groups.safety_boundary: A quota revert remains ineligible without exact provenance, temporal causality, rollback, and outcome verification.

groups.title: Datastore authentication diagnosis and grounded workload recovery
groups.safety_boundary: Selectors and owner chains must identify one exact workload before any restart can become action-eligible.

groups.title: Admission, owner, webhook, probe, storage, rollout, capacity, and autoscaling diagnostics
groups.safety_boundary: Each generalized mechanism must prove positive, negative, stale, truncated, conflicting, and metamorphic behavior before semantic promotion.

groups.title: Provider-neutral dependency and capacity proof mechanisms
groups.safety_boundary: Ontology validates identity, unit, relationship, and evidence eligibility but never senses, judges, approves, executes, or promotes.
